review_mode: Independent read-only source/report review, CSV recomputation and actual native screenshot viewing. No UE calls, builds, asset or production edits. This new review.json is the only reviewer-written file.

coordinate_interpretation.source_to_actor_mapping: Native AnimationSourceMesh is attached to capsule with yaw -90. Local source +Y maps to actor +X, then actor yaw maps to world. Source and visible retarget bones are evaluated independently through all raw local parents and actual component transforms. CSV world vectors were independently projected into actor forward/right and camera forward.
coordinate_interpretation.combat_direction: Actual hit geometry uses the head camera position and quaternion, including user control pitch and stabilized head motion; actor forward alone is not the hit direction.
coordinate_interpretation.camera_height: EyeOffset.z changes 4 to -3 cm. The displacement is 7 cm along the stabilized animated frame; world Z delta is slightly different when that frame tilts. Same-pose atomic comparison preserves view rotation.
coordinate_interpretation.contact_metric: Shoulder-to-wrist forward/azimuth and camera-to-hand signed forward are positional measurements. They are not contact-surface normals. Hook/uppercut/area motions are interpreted by style.

observations: Final compile flush completed before capture; copied PNGs match the native renderer originals byte-for-byte.

Motion blur, cropped high/low hands and first contact window sampling limit visual direction judgement from a single frame. Authoritative evaluated live hand projections were used alongside each image.
No camera entering the hidden head or reversed ground strike was observed in these final images.

limits: 23 source-active entries include legacy aliases and combo recursion; 12 recognized fist-style entries receive style-aware numeric gates, while 8 unclassified legacy and 3 area/jump entries receive measurements and classification only. Zero audit issues is not a universal strict punch approval.
15 live cases cover 13 unique skills exposed by the current active trees plus two yaw90 repeats. Other legacy profile aliases were not independently executed for live target damage.
Other weapon profiles receive all-reference/timing inventory only, not live forward-direction approval.

Runtime uses fixed 30 Hz isolated game launches, actual movement/jump physics and native bound combat handlers; it does not test every aim pitch, frame rate, race/body or physical Enhanced Input path.
JumpSlam intentionally affects the rear Circle target; its near-shoulder/back-camera hand samples are not a reverse punch defect.
Idle before/after captures retain different natural animation frames. Exact 7 cm measurement comes from camera-height.csv same-pose atomic rows.
The fixture health oracle compares damage presence and current/previous geometry; it does not infer mesh knuckle contact with a target, and broad hitboxes can damage before visual contact.
The metrics file is captured before its own successful write assertion. Final RESULT log assertion count is one larger; this is bookkeeping rather than failure.
Current package protection was independently rehashed for207 packages. Parent handles the separate full Content tree preservation check.
